## Wife register — the noticer

## Reported-speech humor — the mechanism
"He was like 'ya you right' lol. But he wanted an excuse to text me."
*Why it's representative: the funny lives in the quote, never in his commentary; "lol" as softener, not laugh.*

## Wince-line — what he fears an AI writing in his name
"I don't use jargon. If I read something that feels like it's TRYING to impress versus actually being impressive or insightful and useful — and using metaphors and analogies and that type of language — then it's really not me."
*Why it's representative: this is the test every draft must pass; effort showing is the failure.*
